# agyr

> agyr is an open-source, pure Bash CLI that rotates Google accounts for Antigravity CLI (agy). When an account hits a 429 quota error, agy-run puts it on cooldown, switches to the next ready account and resumes the same conversation with `agy --conversation`. It runs the official agy binary directly (no proxy), keeps tokens on the local machine (chmod 600 or the OS credential store), and supports Linux and Windows. MIT licensed.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://agyr.luongtrz.id.vn/install.sh | bash`

## Guides
- [Fix Antigravity CLI 429 quota errors](https://agyr.luongtrz.id.vn/fix-antigravity-cli-429-quota/): what the quota error means and how agyr automates failover and resume.
- [Use multiple Google accounts with Antigravity CLI](https://agyr.luongtrz.id.vn/use-multiple-google-accounts-with-antigravity-cli/): saving account slots, checking quota, switching accounts.
- [agyr vs proxy routers](https://agyr.luongtrz.id.vn/agyr-vs-proxy-routers/): comparison of a local CLI swapper with proxy-based routing.
- [Use agyr on Windows](https://agyr.luongtrz.id.vn/agyr-on-windows/): Git Bash, PowerShell and CMD wrappers, the Credential Manager backend and Windows limitations.
- [agyr environment variables and known limitations](https://agyr.luongtrz.id.vn/agyr-environment-variables-and-limitations/): every documented variable with its default, time zone behaviour and known limitations.
- [Delegate coding tasks to agy-task from Claude Code](https://agyr.luongtrz.id.vn/agy-task-with-claude-code/): the reviewer/coder split, worktree workflow, scope checks and exit codes.
